content.title: Get to Know Every Musical Guest for Saturday Night Live Season 51
content.text: Saturday Night Live Season 51 is rocking and rolling with some of music's biggest stars. How to WatchWatch Saturday Night Live Saturdays at 11:30/10:30c on NBC and next day on Peacock.After launching on October 4 with Doja Cat's SNL debut, Studio 8H has been graced with some familiar friends — like Sabrina Carpenter and Brandi Carlile — and new hitmakers. Role Model, sombr, and Olivia Dean all brought the house down in the fall, and December is shaping up to be just as much of a bop. Grammy-nominated musician Dijon marked his first performance on SNL, while both Lily Allen and Cher returned literal decades after their Musical Guest debuts in 2007 and 1987, respectively. You can turn back time to other Musical Guests of the past by heading to Peacock to stream the documentary Ladies & Gentleman ... 50 Years of SNL Music. But if you just want to find out more about this season's lineup? We got you, babe. Get all the details below!RELATED: Meet Saturday Night Live's Season 51 Cast RELATED: Every Host of SNL Season 51 for 2025-2026October 4: Doja Cat Host: Bad BunnyDoja Cat made her SNL debut on the Season 51 premiere with two tracks from her latest album Vie, which was released on September 26. She performed "Gorgeous" while sitting in a giant rose, and brought the house down with a very 80s performance of "AAAHH MEN!"RELATED: Doja Cat Explains the Romantic Meaning of Her New Album's Title, VieRELATED: Watch Bad Bunny's Sketches from Saturday Night Live's October 4 Season 51 PremiereOctober 11: Role Model Host: Amy PoehlerBorn Tucker Pillsbury, Role Model went viral in 2025 for his single "Sally, When the Wine Runs Out." During live performances, he typically invites celebrities up on stage to dance as "Sally," including Kate Hudson, Natalie Portman, Olivia Rodrigo, Troye Sivan and Renee Rapp. Role Model has performed on Today and The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon, and opened for Gracie Abrams' 2024 tour. Season 51 cast member Bowen Yang played Sally during Role Model's Tonight Show performance back in April 2025, but when he performed the hit on SNL, Season 50 Host and Musical Guest Charli xcx joined him on stage as Sally. Role Model also performed the much more lowkey "Some Protector." RELATED: SNL Just Added 5 New Season 51 Cast Members — Including One from Please Don't DestroyOctober 18: Sabrina CarpenterHost: Sabrina Carpenter Sabrina Carpenter killed it when she pulled double duty for her first time as SNL host. She made dreams come true for every little girl who ever sang into a hairbrush with her underwear-clad performance of her no. 1 hit "Manchild," and took a martial arts class for "Nobody's Son." This was the "Espresso" singer's first episode as Host and second as Musical Guest. She previously helped close out Season 49 on May 18, 2024, and made a few other brief appearances. She opened SNL50: The Anniversary Special with Paul Simon and parodied her own song in the third "Domingo" sketch. She popped up again to help May 3, 2025 Host Quinta Brunson sing about being short. So far, there's nothing she can't seem to do. RELATED: Watch Sabrina Carpenter's SNL Sketches & Monologue from October 18, 2025RELATED: Sabrina Carpenter Stole SNL's "Boys Podcast" Sketch As a Tween Interviewing TrumpRELATED: Jake Gyllenhaal and Sabrina Carpenter's SNL Scooby-Doo Parody Has a Wild EndingNovember 1: Brandi CarlileHost: Miles TellerCarlile's November 1 appearance was her fourth episode as Musical Guest, though her third time doing it solo. When Jack Black hosted in Season 50, she co-headlined with Elton John and even appeared in a sketch. Before that, she had performed in Season 47, Season 48, and on SNL50: The Homecoming Concert. On October 24, she released her eighth studio album, Returning To Myself, which chronicles Carlile's musical journey after a long period of collaborating with other stars, including Joni Mitchell. On SNL, she performed the powerful single "Church & State," followed by "Human." RELATED: Miles Teller Is Both Scott Brothers in SNL's "White House Makeover" Demolition SketchRELATED: How Brandi Carlile Helped Joni Mitchell Heal from an Aneurysm to Sing Onstage AgainNovember 8: sombr Host: Nikki GlaserSombr, real name Shane Michael Boose, is a 20-year-old alt rock singer/songwriter whose singles have been going viral online for the past two years. The NYC native released his debut album I Barely Know Her in August 2025 and had hits with "Undressed" and "Back to Friends." He made his TV debut on The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon in May, performing the latter track, and he brought the crowd-pleasing hit back for SNL, along with the catchy single "12 to 12." He's also nominated for Best New Artist at the 2026 Grammys.RELATED: Who Is Sombr? What to Know About SNL's November 8 Musical Guest and His SongsRELATED: Watch Nikki Glaser's SNL Monologue and Sketches from Her November 8 Hosting DebutNovember 15: Olivia Dean Host: Glen PowellOlivia Dean is a U.K. native whose star has slowly been rising over the past few years. She started with self-releasing a few singles on YouTube in 2018, and her debut album Messy came out in 2023. She performed at British music festival Glastonbury in 2024, and gained more recognition in the U.S. with her second album, The Art of Loving. The single "Man I Need" went particularly viral, with more than 11 million views for the music video on YouTube. She performed that hit on SNL, along with the more understated "Let Alone the One You Love." Like fellow Musical Guest sombr, Dean was nominated for Best New Artist at the 2026 Grammys — and she took home the award.RELATED: Six Olivia Dean Songs You'll Fall in Love with Ahead of Her Debut as SNL Musical GuestRELATED: SNL's "AI Photos" Sketch Turns Precious Memories into Surrealist Nightmare FuelRELATED: Glen Powell Crushed It on SNL: Watch His Sketches and Monologue from November 15December 6: Dijon Host: Melissa McCarthySinger and producer Dijon, whose full name is Dijon Duenas, will make his SNL debut on December 6. He's known for collaborating with Mk.gee, Justin Bieber, Bon Iver, and Charli XCX, and even earned two Grammy nominations for his work on Bieber's album Swag.His own solo album, Baby, released on August 15 to critical acclaim, with standout songs including "kindalove" and "Another Baby!" Djion is currently on tour in North America and Europe, and made his acting debut in Paul Thomas Anderson's 2025 film One Battle After Another. RELATED: Who Is Dijon? The Singer-Producer Was in One of 2025's Buzziest MoviesRELATED: Watch Melissa McCarthy's SNL Sketches & Monologue from December 6December 13: Lily Allen Host: Josh O'ConnorFresh off her buzzy new critically acclaimed album West End Girl, British artist Lily Allen returned to SNL for the first time since she performed as Musical Guest in 2007. She turned the stage into an elegant bedroom and sang two songs from the new album: "Sleepwalking" and "Madeline," with help from Dakota Johnson. The album is her first in seven years, and she's heading out on a massive arena tour in 2026. RELATED: Watch Josh O'Connor's Saturday Night Live Sketches from December 13, 2025RELATED: Everything Lily Allen Has Said About the Songs on Her New Album, West End GirlRELATED: Josh O'Connor & Ben Marshall Played Soft, Cozy "Bachelorette Party Strippers"December 20: Cher Host: Ariana GrandeCher first performed as Musical Guest on SNL in 1987, and she returned to help close out 2025 and celebrate the holidays. She performed "DJ, Play a Christmas Song" and "Run Rudolph Run" and even made an appearance in the final sketch as Bowen Yang's Delta Lounge boss. Her memoir, Cher: The Memoir, is now out in paperback, and part two is expected in November 2026. He released his Don't Be Dumb album on January 16, and recently released a music video for single "Punk Rocky" featuring Wolfhard's Stranger Things costar Winona Ryder. Rocky, who appeared in two movies in 2025, Highest 2 Lowest and If I Had Legs I'd Kick You, appeared in the night's "Snack Homiez" sketch, which also saw the return of Sabrina Carpenter as Tayson. The band is fronted by singer Cameron Winter and features Emily Green on guitar, Dominic DiGesu on bass, Max Bassin on drums, and Sam Revaz on the keyboard. Season 51 cast member James Austin Johnson impersonated vocalist Winter in Season 51, in the "Random Duets Christmas Spectacular" sketch. Random Duets Christmas SpectacularRELATED: SNL's One Battle After Another Action Figures Have Fans Calling for the Real ThingJanuary 31: Cardi BHost: Alexander SkarsgårdCardi B made her grand return to SNL nearly eight years after her debut performance as Musical Guest. Back in April 2018, she headlined alongside Host Chadwick Boseman and performed "Bodak Yellow"/"Bartier Cardi," then "Be Careful," famously revealing a pregnancy during the latter.Cardi's latest album — and only her second studio album — Am I the Drama? debuted at no. 1 on the Billboard 200 in September 2025. RELATED: Alexander Skarsgård's Dad Stellan Skarsgård Made Two Hilarious SNL Cameos Last NightRELATED: Pete Davidson Played Border Czar Tom Homan in SNL's "ICE Meeting Cold OpenFebruary 28: Mumford & Sons Host: Connor StorrieMumford & Sons returned for their fourth performance on SNL, just a week after releasing their latest album Prizefighter. They made their SNL debut in 2012, but hadn't been back since 2018. The band performed a cover of "Unchained Melody" in Storrie's "Office Dance" sketch.RELATED: The Hughes Brothers, Hilary Knight & Megan Keller Joined Connor Storrie's SNL MonologueRELATED: Hudson Wiliams Played Connor Storrie's Best Bud in SNL's Adorable "Ice Skating" SketchRELATED: Connor Storrie Brought His Own Original "Stripper" Character to SNLMarch 7: GorillazHost: Ryan GoslingGorillaz made their SNL debut a week after releasing their ninth studio album, The Mountain, on February 27. While band is technically virtual and filled with animated members, real-life founders Damon Albarn and Jamie Hewlett put on a heck of a live show. The group delighted the Studio 8H audience by performing their classic debut single from 2001, "Clint Eastwood."RELATED: Who Are the Members of Gorillaz? Their Lead Singer Fronts Another Famous BandRELATED: SNL Writers' Surprise "Passing Notes" Prank Had Ryan Gosling & Ashley Padilla Breaking RELATED: SNL's "Hegseth Iran Presser" Cold Open Tackles Military Strikes & Government-Made MemesRELATED: Ryan Gosling's "Otezla" SNL Sketch Is a Gloriously Weird Pharma Ad ParodyMarch 14: Harry StylesHost: Harry StylesHarry Styles pulled double duty for his second time on March 14. He first acted as both Host and Musical Guest on November 16, 2019. As a member of One Direction, Styles was Musical Guest in 2012, 2013, and 2014, and returned solo on April 15, 2017. His latest album, Kiss All the Time. Disco, Occasionally is out now. RELATED: Watch Harry Styles' SNL Monologue and Sketches from March 14, 2026RELATED: Sebastian Maniscalco Reacts to Harry Styles' Impression on SNL: "Absolutely..."RELATED: Harry Styles' "MAHAspital" SNL Sketch Imagines The Pitt If It Was Run By RFK Jr.April 4: Jack WhiteHost: Jack BlackWhite is one of the rare musicians to be part of SNL's Five-Timer Club, receiving a jacket at fellow member Woody Harrelson's behest. The musician is certainly a longtime friend to the show: First performing with his duo The White Stripes in 2002, April 4 will mark his sixth stint as an SNL Musical Guest.In addition to featuring prominently in Questlove and Oz Rodriguez's Ladies and Gentleman....50 Years of SNL Music documentary on Peacock, and closed out February 2025's SNL50: The Homecoming Concert.RELATED: Jack Black & Jack White's Upcoming SNL Episode Was Foretold By Woody Harrelson in 2023RELATED: Watch Jack White's Electric First Saturday Night Live Performances from 2002May 2: Olivia Rodrigo Host: Olivia Rodrigo Rodrigo will perform for the third time (and host for the first!) during SNL's May 2nd episode. The "vampire" singer is readying the release of her next album, you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love this June. May 9: Noah Kahan Host: Matt Damon Kahan releases his fourth studio album, The Great Divide, on Friday, April 24. The singer-songwriter is known for tracks like "Stick Season," "Northern Attitude," and "You're Gonna Go Far." He'll be joined on SNL by host Matt Damon, whose next film, The Odyssey, arrives in July. May 16: Paul McCartney Host: Will Ferrell The living legend and former Beatle himself will perform for a fifth time at Studio 8H for the Season 51 finale. With such a historic Musical Guest, it's only fitting the Host is Ferrell, a beloved, iconic SNL alum.
